programs.placementNote: Official PGDM 2027-29 admission page 'Placement Statistics': highest CTC 41.36 LPA, average 13.69 LPA, top-10% average 23.68 LPA, median 12.54 LPA. The page does not name the batch (most likely 2024-26). Audit not stated.

selectionProcess.detail: January 2027; admission decision February 2027. Exams accepted and selection weights are on imi-k.edu.in programme pages that could not be fetched (HTTP 522).
